note: Eleven canonical scientific products plus one supporting GPU-parity witness. Relative hints are local search hints only; absolute paths, hostnames and user profiles are deliberately absent.

external_reference_commits.name: convexadam_mind_ssc
external_reference_commits.note: MIND-SSC reference implementation commit recorded inside the C0 product. It is not a CTCF commit and is absent from the CTCF object database, so it is never resolved with git; it is pinned by value through a json_equals assertion instead.

products.summary: Primary scientific C2 product; owner of EV-SEARCH-003.
Non-canonical GPU-parity control recorded after the search_gate_common refactor; owner of EV-OPS-014. It witnesses behaviour preservation and is not the scientific owner of any C2 number.
Frozen C3a label-free descriptor gate. It authenticated the SG-C2-PARITY tree; SG-C2-SCIENCE remains the scientific owner of the C2 numbers through the nine-file payload equivalence.
Frozen numerical-stability gate over the C3a decision.
Frozen C5 recovery product. The RUN_ID suffix names the producer phase while the root native manifest was written by the recovery consumer head, so a git sha must never be read off the RUN_ID.
Frozen C6 V2 true-pyramid causal gate.

relations.note: The parity run reproduces the scientific payload byte for byte after the refactor; it does not thereby become the scientific owner of the C2 numbers.
